sub_graphs.title: Cancun Block Instructions: Block Environment Access
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime behavior of block-related EVM opcodes that read blockchain environmental data

nodes.label: EVM Executing Instruction
nodes.description: EVM is processing the current instruction, ready to execute a block opcode

nodes.label: Execute BLOCKHASH Opcode
nodes.description: Pop block number from stack, validate range (within 256 blocks), retrieve hash from block_env.block_hashes

nodes.label: Execute COINBASE Opcode
nodes.description: Read block beneficiary address from block_env.coinbase and push to stack

nodes.label: Execute TIMESTAMP Opcode
nodes.description: Read block timestamp from block_env.time and push to stack

nodes.label: Execute NUMBER Opcode
nodes.description: Read current block number from block_env.number and push to stack

nodes.label: Execute PREVRANDAO Opcode
nodes.description: Read beacon chain randomness from block_env.prev_randao and push to stack

nodes.label: Execute GASLIMIT Opcode
nodes.description: Read block gas limit from block_env.block_gas_limit and push to stack

nodes.label: Execute CHAINID Opcode
nodes.description: Read chain identifier from block_env.chain_id and push to stack

nodes.label: Stack Updated with Block Data
nodes.description: Stack contains the requested block environment value, PC incremented

nodes.label: Zero Hash Returned
nodes.description: BLOCKHASH returned zero because requested block is out of range (>256 blocks ago, current, or future)

edges.label: Block in valid range, hash retrieved
Block out of range, return zero

external_entities.name: Block Proposer
external_entities.description: Validator/miner who sets block environmental data (coinbase, timestamp)

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Block Instructions: Gas Costs
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas consumption for block-related opcodes

nodes.label: Gas Available for Execution
nodes.description: EVM has sufficient gas to potentially execute the instruction

nodes.label: Charge Gas for BLOCKHASH
nodes.description: Deduct 20 gas units for BLOCKHASH execution

nodes.label: Charge Base Gas
nodes.description: Deduct 2 gas units (GAS_BASE) for COINBASE, TIMESTAMP, NUMBER, PREVRANDAO, GASLIMIT, CHAINID

nodes.label: Gas Successfully Deducted
nodes.description: Gas cost charged, execution proceeds

nodes.label: Out of Gas Error
nodes.description: Insufficient gas available, execution halts with OutOfGasError

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Block Instructions: Stack Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the stack validation for block-related opcodes

nodes.label: Block Opcode Received
nodes.description: EVM has fetched a block-related opcode for execution

nodes.label: Validate Stack for BLOCKHASH
nodes.description: Check stack has at least 1 element to pop, and less than 1024 elements

nodes.label: Validate Stack for Push
nodes.description: Check stack has less than 1024 elements for opcodes that only push

nodes.label: Stack Validation Passed
nodes.description: Stack meets requirements, proceed with execution

nodes.label: Stack Underflow Error
nodes.description: BLOCKHASH failed: insufficient stack elements

nodes.label: Stack Overflow Error
nodes.description: Cannot push: stack already at 1024 elements

ambiguities.text: PREVRANDAO provides 'beacon chain randomness' but the degree of predictability is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume PREVRANDAO can be predicted by validators up to some degree. Contracts should not use it for high-value randomness without additional entropy sources.

ambiguities.text: TIMESTAMP is controlled by miners 'within limits' but the acceptable tolerance is not specified in this module
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume timestamp can vary within protocol-defined bounds (typically ~15 seconds). Contracts should allow tolerance for time-dependent logic.

implicit_assumptions.description: block_env is populated with correct, validated block data before EVM execution begins
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Corrupted block environment could expose incorrect chain state to contracts, enabling manipulation

implicit_assumptions.description: Block proposers cannot manipulate PREVRANDAO beyond their natural ability to see the value before others
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Predictable randomness could enable front-running or manipulation of randomness-dependent contracts

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot forge block hashes in the recent 256-block window
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: BLOCKHASH-based commit-reveal schemes could be broken
